reviews.t: One of the best pastry in Paris! I really enjoyed everything that I tried starting from the madelein until the pain chocolat. Also the eclair was very good, but maybe not the best one that I have tried. Overall a very nice experience and also the prices was good
Ma boulangerie préférée. Pain et viennoiseries excellents. Accueil sympathique.

Boulangerie de quartier, commerçants très sympas, le pain est bon ainsi que les viennoiseries et patisseries ! Attention à l'heure du déjeuner venir tôt car les scolaires dévalisent sandwichs et repas chaud!
Accueil chaleureux et bon pain, de nombreuses viennoiseries de qualité.

I got 2 baguettes : la Moulinoise (€1.15) & Tradition (€1.15) along with a pain au chocolat (€1.20).

Both baguettes were great, certainly made with the same dough that lends the bread a perfect chew with a thin crunch exterior. I think the only difference is the cut pattern on top, Xs on the Moulinoise and one long slash down the middle on the tradition. I actually got a fresh tradition, which is a nice treat but ended up enjoying the extra crunch on the Moulinoise a bit more, which is the only discernible difference I could sense.

Pain au chocolat was great, although while most boulangerie use two sticks of chocolate in each, La Moulinoise used only one in the pastry I ate. It changes the balance of pastry to chocolate and gives it a much more croissant flaky bite to it rather than the ooey gooey chew that many look for in a pain au chocolat. It was highly enjoyable, and a great flaky delicacy.

Proche de notre hôtel, nous sommes venus dans cette boulangerie pour manger quelque chose de rapide.
Les boissons chaudes ne sont pas à notre goût… le chocolat était beaucoup trop sucré et le café n’était pas bon
Heureusement que les viennoiseries sont bonnes

Pour du pain oui. Mais les viennoiseries c'est du congelé...
